method.volatility: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of simple daily returns of Tencent forward-adjusted closes, multiplied by sqrt(252).
method.turnover: Percent of tradable A shares, not total company shares or free-float adjusted index shares.
method.history_turnover: Arithmetic mean of 20 native daily turnover rates, 2026-10-08 through 2026-11-04. THS supplies first 19 days at 0.001 percentage-point precision; Tencent supplies Nov 4 closing quote at 0.01 precision. No estimation from current shares.
